main_text.p: ac thema esse בְּרֵי; ac significare Spacium via, quantum homo conficit à mane usq; ad paftum. Quidam Jugerum, Stadium, Spacium exiguum, interpretantur.
מִכְבָּר m. Cribrum, Exod.27.4. Conftr: וְאֶת־מִכְבַּר הַנְּחשֶׁת Et cribrum æneum, Exod.35.16.

כָּבַשׁ Subegit, Subjecit, Subjugavit: Domuit: Præt. וְכִבְּשׁוּ Et subegerint, Zach.9.15. Niph. Præt. נִכְבְּשָׁה Et domita fuerit, Num.32.22. Part. נִכְבָּשׁוֹת Subjecta, Nehem.5. v.5. Pih. Præter. כִּבֵּשׁ Subegerat, 2.Sam.8.11.
כִּבְשָׁן m. Fornax, Gen.19.28. proprie lateraria.

כֶּבֶשׂ m. Ovis, Agnus, Levit.4.32. Plural. כְּבָשִׂים Exod.29.38. Aff. כִּבְשִׂי Agnorum meorum, Job.31. v.20. Fœm. כִּבְשָׂה Agna, Lev.14.10. vel כִּבְשָׂה 2.Sam.12. v.3. Conftr. כִּבְשַׂת הָאִישׁ Agnam viri iftius, 2.Sam.12. v.4. Plur. כִּבְשׂוֹת Agnæ, Gen.21.29. Conftr. כִּבְשׂוֹת הַצֹּאן Agnas gregis, v.28.
כָּרַב Chald. Mentiri, ab Hebraeo כָּזַב, permutatis pro more t & ז. [?]
כִּרְבָּה f. Chald. Mendacium: Mendax, Dan.2.9.
כָּר m. כִּירוּד m. Scintilla: Plur. Conftr. כִּידוּדֵי אֵשׁ Scintillæ ignis, Job.41.10.
כִּרְכַּר m. Pyropus, Lapis pretiosus, quasi Scintillans dictus, Jesa.54.12. prima radicalis geminata.
כַּר f. Cadus, Hydria: כַּד הַמַּיִם Cadus farinæ, 1.Reg.17. v.14. Aff. וַתְּמַלֵּא כַּדָּהּ Et implevit hydriam suam, Genes.24. v.16. Plural. וַכַּדִּים רֵיקִים Et hydrias vacuas, Judic.7.16.
* כַּרְנָה כַּרְן Chaldaicum, Vide in דְּן.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some Hebrew forms are hard to read at this scan resolution; the Hebrew words are transcribed as best seen and may contain errors. The header of the entry after כִּירוּד is large and uncertain (marked by its position; left as כָּר). "כָּרַב" with its etymology note is doubtful. The Hebrew of the first line and of the Chaldee entries (כַּרִי, כַּרְנָה) is uncertain. No marginal notes on this page.
